title: Display Activity rings only when relevant

statement.en: Display Activity rings when they're relevant to the app's purpose.
statement.ja: appの目的に関連する場合にActivity ringsを表示する。

conditions: Health, fitness, and HealthKit-related apps are contexts where people commonly expect Activity rings.
exceptions: Workout metrics and summary screens are examples, not required placements.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Activity rings experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
